jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.   As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About the job As HR Country Manager, you will be supporting Alfa Laval's Scaling for Future direction, with a focus on Denmark, with 2000 employees and five Danish legal entities. The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own!  The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. The key priority will be to ensure HR alignment across the legal entities and compliance with Danish legislation and collective agreements. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development.  You will act as:     HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov.     HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council     HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization.     Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team.     The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas.  Operational responsibilities:    Plan and drive national HR focus areas for the five Danish entities aligned with the business strategy and People Strategy.     Develop and implement people policies, processes, routines, guidelines, tools and analytics.     Ensure country-wide consistency for benefits frameworks, allowances, principles, policies.     Coordinate the salary budget and review process in Denmark together with the Employee Relations team in HR Shared Services     Drive, support and inspire management in organizational, leadership, and competence development.     Coordinate local HR activities at the Søborg site, including collaboration with employee representatives and relevant councils.  Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson.  Who you are You are an experienced and confident HR professional, who is ready to take on the role as a trusted sparring partner for managers and leaders. You bring a genuine interest in understanding the business and getting to know our people. To succeed we see you as a strong communicator able to create engagement, participation, and clarity. You are people-oriented and build good solid relationships and have the know-how in leading through others. You make decisions with overall perspective and consider the needs of the entire organization.  Requirements:     Solid experience from a similar role within a larger international matrix organization and a strong background in country-level HR governance.     In-depth knowledge of Danish labour law, industrial relations, negotiations and collective agreements.     Experience in leading and coordinating change work, developing and implementing HR processes, routines, and guidelines.     Good ability to work in HR systems     Excellent communication skills in Danish and English and the ability to formulate clear and well-structured routines, guidelines, and strategic documents.     Completed university education in HR of at least 180 ECTS credits, or an equivalent education deemed relevant by the employer.     Driving license. We do not accept applications via email, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 18, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!  While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing close to our office in Søborg, Denmark. We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.  #LI-CL1

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
• Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
• Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
• Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions) 
• Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.You have:
• A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems 
• Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects 
• Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar 
• Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
• A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Specialist  Reblade ApS — Careers
jobs.description:
Supply Chain Specialist

Mørke, Denmark

About Reblade:

Reblade is a Danish technology company founded in 2020, developing autonomous drone-

based robotic systems for leading edge repair of wind turbine blades.

We design, develop, manufacture and test our own technology, combining mechanical

engineering, electronics, software and robotics.

Our international team works in English, and we collaborate with major wind energy

operators, universities and technology partners across Europe.

We are strengthening our supply chain and purchasing capabilities.

About the position:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Specialist to take responsibility for purchasing, supplier

management, inventory coordination and procurement cost control.

You will work closely with our engineering, production and finance teams to ensure that

components and materials are available when needed, suppliers meet our requirements, and

purchasing costs remain under control.

The position combines operational purchasing with supplier development, cost analysis and

process improvement.

Key responsibilities:

Purchasing and supplier management

• Manage purchasing activities, including RFQs, purchase orders, order confirmations and delivery

follow-up.

• Identify, evaluate and qualify suppliers based on quality, cost, lead time and delivery performance.

• Negotiate prices, commercial terms and supplier agreements.

• Maintain supplier records, purchasing documentation and performance evaluations.

• Resolve supplier-related issues, including delivery delays, incorrect shipments and quality concerns.

Inventory and supply chain coordination

• Coordinate material requirements with engineering and production teams.

• Monitor stock levels, reorder points and material availability.

• Support purchasing planning for prototype development, testing and production activities.

• Identify supply chain risks and propose alternative suppliers or sourcing solutions.

Cost control and administration

• Maintain purchasing cost overviews, spending reports and supplier price comparisons.

• Monitor purchasing budgets and identify cost reduction opportunities.

• Coordinate invoice verification, purchase order matching and payment follow-up with finance.

• Support the development and implementation of purchasing procedures and supply chain processes.

Your profile:

Required qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of experience in purchasing, procurement or supply chain management.

• Experience working with suppliers, quotations, purchase orders and delivery coordination.

• Understanding of procurement cost control, supplier pricing and commercial negotiations.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Good analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or similar tools.

• Professional English communication skills, both written and spoken.

What we offer:

• A permanent, full-time position in a growing Danish technology company.

• Direct responsibility for purchasing and supplier management activities.

• The opportunity to establish and improve purchasing and supply chain processes.

• A workplace where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have a direct impact.

Application:

Send us your CV and a short introduction outlining your relevant experience.

Applications will be reviewed continuously, and interviews will be arranged with suitable

candidates.

Contact: Stine Alexander Westergaard saw@reblade.dk // Call me: +45 42411163

Workplace: Reblade ApS, Mørke, Denmark

Starting date: As soon as possible, by agreement.
